name: Order Totals Reconcile

requirements.description: Order subtotal, discounts, shipping, tax and grand total must reconcile exactly according to canonical money precision rules.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
Use canonical Phase 11 schemas as the data model; do not create shadow transaction models.
